description: This file is a Perl module script for checking database integrity, including schema validation, relationship consistency, and data validation for a specific project named Coocook. It defines a class with methods to perform various database checks and validations.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Dbck
classes.description: A Perl class for performing database integrity checks similar to filesystem fsck, tailored for the Coocook project.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute all database integrity checks.

methods.name: check_schema
methods.description: Checks if the database schema matches the expected schema for SQLite, comparing table definitions.

methods.name: check_relationships
methods.description: Verifies referential integrity and consistency of project-related relationships across tables.

methods.name: check_sqlite_numeric_values
methods.description: Checks for invalid numeric values and empty strings in SQLite database columns.

methods.name: check_fc_values
methods.description: Checks for duplicate organization/user names and correctness of 'name_fc' fields.

methods.name: check_url_name_values
methods.description: Validates URL-friendly name fields for projects.

methods.name: check_unit_conversions_values
methods.description: Ensures unit conversion entries are normalized with unit1_id <= unit2_id.

methods.name: _debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
